description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Excise Duty on Food Preparation, Beverage, Cigars etc.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of excise duty rates through a statutory order under the Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No. 13 of 1989. It contains detailed regulatory changes to tax rates on various products (beverages, tobacco, petroleum products) and rescinds previous gazette notifications. While it mentions Minister Mangala Samaraweera, this is in his capacity as the authority making the regulatory order, not as a personnel appointment or portfolio assignment. The core content is regulatory/legal in nature, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5).
